title: Record tool refuses a review record whose rounds restart at 1
why: A lane on #3060 got past the round-3 and net-value ask: after a PASS fix verifier, it posted a fresh round 1 record (haiku) at the new head, and merge --review-record accepted it. Harm stopped: a guard change merging without its net-value review.
note: Fix: merge --review-record refuses a record whose rounds restart at 1 when an earlier record on the same PR already holds rounds or a Fix check. Only exception: a new branch with a new PR. Kind: check change, normal queue. Related: review-record-before-any-push, record-replacement-pr-rounds, decision pr-review-record. 03:01 CST Nov 13, coordinator: lane session_013NEJKzYJexYzf7UW9YXcDp builds it. Also cover the path fix verifier, then round 3. The tool demands rounds 1, 2, 3 in a row. #3060's real order was round 1, fix verifier, round 3 (Sonnet, net value), then a Sonnet round 2 at the same head, run after round 3 only to fill the gap. So the record's order did not match what happened. With the fix, no filler round 2 is needed.
